\[
\begin{aligned}
\int_V L_1^pL_2^qL_3^rL_4^s\,dV
&=\frac{p!q!r!s!}{(p+q+r+s+3)!}\,6V\\[6pt]
\int_V L_iL_j\,dV
&=
\begin{cases}
\displaystyle\frac{1!1!}{(1+1+3)!}\,6V
=\frac{6}{5!}V
=\frac{1}{20}V &(i\ne j)\\
\displaystyle\frac{2!}{(1+1+3)!}\,6V
=\frac{12}{5!}V
=\frac{1}{10}V &(i=j)
\end{cases}\\[6pt]
\int_V L_i\,dV
&=\frac{1!}{(1+3)!}\,6V
=\frac{6}{4!}V
=\frac{1}{4}V\\[6pt]
\int_S L_1^pL_2^qL_3^r\,dS
&=\frac{p!q!r!}{(p+q+r+2)!}\,2S\\[6pt]
\int_S L_i\,dS
&=\frac{1}{(1+2)!}\,2S
=\frac{1}{3}S
\end{aligned}
\]
